csv_project_name: CM for Public Works West Side Campus
csv_scope_of_work: The City seeks to hire a qualified CM/GC to guide the City through the pre-construction phase and construction of a new Public Works West Side Facility and a new Public Works Water Annex Facility located within the existing Public Works yard described within this RFP. The City anticipates the CM/GC will provide pre-construction and construction services in conjunction with the Design Team lead by the architect, Blalock & Partners, also referred to within this RFP as Architect . The CM/GC shall work proactively with the Architect and the City to design a project within the approved construction budget.
